name: Doji na Imouto no Ana wa Ore no Mono
original_name: ドジな妹の穴は俺のモノ
source:
Little sister Hiromi.
A gentle personality in a clumsy body.
That clumsiness is how I discovered her secret.
Hiromi's body is ever-wet and ready, and I want it.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ184781.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
